verdict.rationale: Self-hosting is a fair question for a cloud platform, since a buyer could reasonably ask whether its services can run on their own infrastructure, so the axis applies. The evidence pack documents no way to self-host Azure's core platform. Running the Azure CLI locally or in a Docker container is a client tool for managing Azure-hosted resources, not self-hosting the product, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can self-host the core product
